meanings.gloss: die beiden: the two (of them), both
meanings.morph: after an article or possessive; dative plural

sentences.en: The two of them are friends.
I know the two of them.

sentences.text: Ich habe die beiden gestern gesehen.
sentences.en: I saw the two of them yesterday.

sentences.text: Er war mit den beiden in Berlin.
sentences.en: He was in Berlin with the two of them.

sentences.text: Von den beiden gefällt mir dieses besser.
sentences.en: Of the two, I like this one better.

sentences.text: Meine beiden Kinder leben in London.
sentences.en: Both my children live in London.

sentences.text: Ich habe die beiden Bücher gekauft.

sentences.en: The two girls are playing together.
